evidence.explanation: JS randomOneBased defaults to rnd and is called twice per attempt; the C-only edge is an injected-parameter alias.
evidence.proof: Eight C/JS comparisons through the production coordinate chooser on publicly initialized/painted maps. Both terrain modes cover first-hit, 100th-hit, deterministic x-major scan fallback after 100 rejected pairs, and real default RNG. C receives checked shared draw tapes; not independent RNG parity or all map geometries.
evidence.control: Immediate chosen point and all-eligible default-RNG maps; fallback selects 2,7 before 7,2, while a 100th-attempt hit chooses 7,2.
